reviews.review: This game is like if ratchet and clank had a baby with hell divers. 10/10

I want my life back but the Aranea spitting webs from half a continent away says no. Which is totally fine, because being dragged across multiple city blocks like a sack full of bullet-spewing rocks is a fun experience.

This game's loot table legitimately makes MMO slop like WoW or Black Desert look reasonable and easily attainable in comparison, except playing this game doesn't count as an act of self-harm (unless you're playing Single Player like me or are a Ranger/Wing Diver main) or otherwise a time investment akin to a job except you don't get paid for it.

No, seriously, the loot in this game legit is one of the most painful things imaginable, because it relies on both mission number AND difficulty. If it wasn't a Japanese company that developed this, I'd have mistaken it for some kind of CIA psyop to see just how far a "reasonable" living being would go just because of an insignificant percent of a chance for a weapon upgrade. Which is why it's more than valid to use Cheat Engine solely to pick everything up after a mission to make grinding a teeny bit easier. [strike]also to increase drop rates but that's a different story entirely. You didn't hear that from me.[/strike]

On the plus side, EDF 5 is a great way to get a handle on one's arachnophobia, on account of having a gun that can ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ delete the squishy little twits in one or two mouse clicks.
On the downside, EDF 5 will make you hate just about every other possible member of the insect family. Especially pill bugs.

Sure, it's crusty. Sure, when the local Air Raider starts throwing every single flare and targeting smoke out, the game becomes a Microsoft Powerpoint if it was able to run on an ancient box computer. Sure, balancing is more or less nonexistent (in both good and bad ways) and missions kinda become a massive slog around 3/4ths of the way through the game. But every game of EDF 5 is a fantastic way to strangle every active neuron into silence and have simple, stupid fun. Shoot anthro frogs. Shoot aliens. Shoot a bunch of bugs. Heck, shoot your own teammates and pretend it was an accident, or don't and watch the chaos multiply.

9/10, would be the alpha team with passion and camaraderie again. At least when it's not involving a mission with ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ "rolling monsters" and those stupid laser-spewing aliens in the same breath.
I learned that frogs are humans apparently
What can I say? The game is a ton of fun! Nonstop action, campy humor, diverse classes and enemies! I really don't mind the somewhat dated graphics, heck it suits the game perfectly!
